name: Xolotl
subtitle: Emissary of Souls
description: Disruptor capable of many attacks and debuffs.
lore: Dog-headed Xolotl, vicious twin of Quetzalcoatl, holds mastery over fire, disease, misfortune, and monsters. Believing that the wounds of the Shattering can be healed by a new sun—which requires a multitude of sacrifices—he travels the lands gathering monsters. He means to gain mastery over them all, scatter them across different Realms, and set them loose to claim the victims required.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when placing a [Buff] on an ally.

Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Empowered Talon Strike
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy. Increase this hero’s Divinity by 50 and place a random [Buff] on a random ally for 1 turn. Possible buffs are [mechanic:spd-up-ii], [mechanic:atk-up-ii], [mechanic:init-up-ii] or [mechanic:def-up-ii]. Will prioritise allies who trigger Path of the Psychopomp.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also place a random [Buff] on this hero for 1 turn.

skills.name: Twin’s Benediction
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy and [Mirror]1 random [Buff] from the target. Also increase the duration of 1 random [Buff] on all allies.

skills.name: Twin Convergence
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy and place [mechanic:sharpen-ii] on all allies for 2 turns. If Quetzalcoatl is on the team, they will join the attack.

skills.name: Path of the Psychopomp
skills.description: Has a 20% chance to join an ally in attacking. When joining an attack, will heal 5%MAX HP all allies and increase their Divinity by 5%.
skills.awakening_bonus: Will also increase the Turn Meter of all allies by 5%.

imprint_passive: Has a 10% chance to join an ally in attacking. When joining an attack, will heal 5%MAX HP all allies and increase their Divinity by 5%.
